name: Split-View
description: Split the tab content area into two resizable panes side by side.

name: Omni Bangs
description: DuckDuckGo-style bang shortcuts in the address bar (e.g., !w Wikipedia).

name: Gradient Shimmer
description: Animated canvas-based shimmer effect on the new tab page background.

name: Smooth Scrolling
description: Animate smoothly when scrolling page content.

name: Override software rendering list
description: Overrides the built-in software rendering list and enables GPU-acceleration on unsupported system configurations.

name: GPU rasterization
description: Use GPU to rasterize web content.

name: Zero-copy rasterization
description: Raster threads write directly to GPU memory associated with tiles.

name: Disable GPU hardware acceleration
description: Disables GPU hardware acceleration and falls back to software rendering.

name: Auto Dark Mode for Web Contents
description: Automatically render all web contents using a dark theme.

name: Parallel downloading
description: Enable parallel downloading to accelerate download speed.

name: Back-forward cache
description: Enables back-forward cache for faster navigation history traversal.

name: Limit Disk Cache to 50MB
description: Restricts the maximum disk space used by the web cache to 50MB.

name: In-process GPU
description: Runs the GPU process as a thread inside the browser process instead of a separate process.

name: Disable background networking
description: Disables various background network tasks, such as extension updates, safe browsing, and diagnostic reporting.

name: Experimental QUIC protocol
description: Enable experimental QUIC protocol support (HTTP/3).

name: Experimental Web Platform features
description: Enables experimental Web Platform features that are in development.

name: Disable Site Isolation
description: Disables site isolation trials. May improve memory usage at the cost of security.

name: Disable Web Security
description: Don't enforce the same-origin policy (SOP). ONLY use for local development/testing.

name: Ignore Certificate Errors
description: Ignores SSL/TLS certificate errors on all connections.

name: Disable WebGL
description: Disables WebGL APIs to prevent rendering 3D graphics.

name: Disable JavaScript JIT compiler
description: Disables the Just-In-Time compiler in V8. This improves security/sandboxing but reduces JS execution speed.

name: Incognito mode
description: Forces Chromium engine into private browsing mode (no local cache or history saved).

name: Autoplay policy
description: Forces user gesture requirement for autoplaying audio/video.

name: Mute Audio
description: Mutes all audio output from the browser.

name: Auto-open DevTools for tabs
description: Automatically opens a Developer Tools window for every tab.
